report_name: Crawley Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan
how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used to identify likely route corridors for cycling to work or school by linking census SOA centroids to employment locations and schools. It was used to compare and confirm corridors identified through manual mapping and local knowledge, though it was not the sole source of data.
other_tools_developed: Active Mode Appraisal Tool (AMAT), Route Selection Tool (RST), and Walking Route Assessment Tool (WRAT)
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP underpinned a successful £21m government bid from the Towns Fund and Future High Street funds to provide a key commuter cycle route linking Gatwick Airport station, Manor Royal Business District, and the town centre.
pct_usage_quote: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) aims to identify likely route corridors where cycling has the greatest potential to grow and provides estimated figures for their use.
